text: Provides official APM agents for Go, Java, .NET, Node.js, PHP, Python, and Ruby
quote: Monitor application performance across your stack. We've got agents for Go, Java, .NET, Node.js, PHP, Python, and Ruby.

text: Exposes a GraphQL API (NerdGraph) to query and configure New Relic data/features
quote: NerdGraph is our GraphQL-format API that lets you query New Relic data and configure some New Relic features.

text: NRQL query language lets you build charts, troubleshoot, and set alert conditions
quote: NRQL can help you: Create a new chart, Answer a specific question for the purpose of troubleshooting or business analysis, Set up NRQL-based alerts

text: Supports instrumenting services via OpenTelemetry for platform-agnostic observability
quote: Instrument your service with OpenTelemetry and gain platform-agnostic observability.

text: Lets you define custom alert thresholds, conditions and notification targets
quote: You define the data to watch, the thresholds that if exceeded mean an issue, who is notified, and how.

text: Supports defining and tracking SLIs and SLOs for applications
quote: With New Relic, you can define and consume service level indicators (SLIs) and service level objectives (SLOs) for your applications.

text: UI for building and sharing custom charts and dashboards
quote: Through our UI you can build and share tailored user-friendly charts and visualizations.

text: Dashboards can be shared externally via public live dashboard URLs
quote: Share dashboards with stakeholders outside your New Relic organization via publicly accessible live dashboard URLs.

text: Built-in assistant lets you ask questions and explore telemetry in plain language
quote: It allows you to ask questions, troubleshoot issues, and explore telemetry data using plain language.

text: AI assistant can help you construct or fix NRQL queries
quote: If you're struggling to get a query to work, ask our AI assistant to help you.

text: Offers an official MCP server integration connecting AI dev tools to New Relic data
quote: This update provides a standardized, scalable way to connect your favorite AI development tools directly to the rich context of the New Relic platform

text: Instant full-text search across ingested logs
quote: Instantly search through your logs.

text: Free tier includes 100 GB/month of data ingest at no cost
quote: 100 GB of free data ingest/month

text: Search for entities across all connected New Relic accounts (via GitHub tooling)
quote: Entity Search: Search for entities across all your New Relic accounts

text: Manage/apply tags across entities in bulk
quote:
Entity Search: Search for entities across all your New Relic accounts
- Entity Tagging: Manage tags across all of your entities

text: Deployment markers record APM application deployments for correlation with performance changes
quote: Deployment Markers: Easily record an APM Application deployment within New Relic.

text: Real-time visibility into multi-cloud and Kubernetes spend
quote: Gain real-time visibility into multi-cloud and Kubernetes spend.

text: AI can automatically identify friction points in session replay video, skipping manual review
quote: Skip searching the video. Have AI identify friction points for you.

text: Can automatically control behavior and token usage across an AI stack
quote: Control behavior and token usage across your AI stack—automatically.

text: Monitors serverless AWS Lambda functions using CloudWatch data plus code-level instrumentation
quote: Monitor your serverless AWS Lambda functions using both CloudWatch data and code-level instrumentation.

text: Synthetic monitoring simulates end-user activity and API calls from global locations
quote: Simulate end-user activity and API calls from locations around the world, so you can find problems before your users do.

text: Provides an interactive NerdGraph API explorer for experimenting with API queries
quote: An easy way to experiment with the NerdGraph API is to use the NerdGraph API explorer.

text: MCP server converts plain-English questions into NRQL queries automatically
quote: Ask questions in plain English, and the MCP server converts them to NRQL to get results—even if you're not a NRQL expert.

text: APM agents can report application logs directly without third-party log shippers
quote: Use our APM agents to report logs. ... it lets you easily report application logs, with no additional third-party solutions required.

text: APM agents add metadata to logs for in-context correlation and forward logs to New Relic
quote: By default, our APM agents do two things: add metadata to your logs, which gives you logs in context (ability to see logs data in various relevant places in our platform) and forward your logs to New Relic.

text: Provides a unified log management platform alongside other telemetry data
quote: New Relic offers a fast, scalable log management platform so you can connect your logs with the rest of your telemetry and infrastructure data in a single place.

text: Infrastructure monitoring covers hosts, containers, providers, and network
quote: Get visibility into hosts, containers, providers, network, and infrastructure.

text: NRQL is a SQL-like language powering both ad hoc queries and built-in charts/dashboards
quote: New Relic Query Language (NRQL) is a SQL-like language for querying your New Relic data. The same query language that powers New Relic's built-in charts and dashboards is available to you

text: OpenTelemetry integration lets you gather and analyze telemetry from apps and infrastructure
quote: OpenTelemetry is a toolkit to gather telemetry from applications, infrastructure (hosts, Kubernetes, etc.), and more. By integrating OpenTelemetry with New Relic, you can leverage a wide range of platform capabilities to analyze the data an

text: Alerts can evaluate any signal against thresholds or abnormal-behavior detection and route notifications to teams
quote: With alerts, you can: Configure any signal to be evaluated against a threshold, or if it exhibits abnormal behavior. ... Route issues to the correct system or team using notifications

text: MCP update standardizes connecting AI dev tools to New Relic platform context, breaking down data silos
quote: This update provides a standardized, scalable way to connect your favorite AI development tools directly to the rich context of the New Relic platform, breaking down data silos and accelerating AI-driven operations.

text: Moves beyond AI assistance to automated remediation of issues
quote: Move beyond assistance to automated remediation.
